'''2018 European Championship Day 2 György Póra LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[György Póra]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[György Póra]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
